basic_profile.bio: Just a guy navigating through life in the Southern US. I'm into programming, especially game development, and spend my free time exploring the mysteries of conjure and hoodoo practices. I work part-time at Chick-fil-A, which gives me the flexibility to dive deep into my hobbies. Not a fan of huge crowds, but I enjoy meaningful one-on-one conversations. I'm single and content, focusing on self-growth. You can usually find me online during late evenings when the world quiets down.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, having completed some college courses. Most of my game development skills are self-taught through online resources and community forums. My interest in hoodoo and conjure is purely personal and stems from a deep-rooted cultural curiosity, nurtured by reading and connecting with online communities.
